2646.title: Codex authentication error omits the login recovery step
2646.rootCauseOneLine: The model picker replaces the Codex login command with a generic authentication message.
2646.proposedFix: Load provider health after an authentication model error and show its declared login command in the picker.
2646.caveats: The safety rules prohibited access to the external attachment. The test verifies the missing recovery step, but it does not verify the reporter's local authentication state.

currentVerification.scope: Actual server mapping and picker guidance data; missing-CLI link present; authentication recovery step absent; no live Codex or visual verification.
